```{r, echo=FALSE, warning = FALSE}
annealing_temperature_checklist = get_annealing_temperature(hl60.gus.file, separator) 

if (runType == "absolute"){
	oft_gusb_ratio_checklist = "N.A."
} else {
	if (is.na(params$dx.baseline)){
		oft_gusb_ratio_checklist = paste(round(dx.baseline, digits=3), " (in-plate)")
	} else {
		oft_gusb_ratio_checklist = paste(round(dx.baseline, digits=3), " (preset)")
	}
}


hl60_gusb_dilution_checklist = params$hl60.gus.dilutionX 

fu_gusb_dilution_checklist = fu.gus.dilution.factor

overall_qc_checklist = extract_value(final.qc.call)


if (length(params$dx.gus) == 0) {

	oft_assay_checklist = "N.A."

} else {

	dx.gus.info <- get_merged_info(c(params$dx.gus))
	dx.cell.concentration <- dx.gus.info[1, "concentration"]


	if (is.na(dx.cell.concentration)){

		oft_assay_checklist = "N.A."
		
	} else {

		dx.marker.info <- get_merged_info(c(params$dx.marker))

		oft_assay_checklist = round(dx.marker.info[1, "concentration"] / dx.cell.concentration, digits=3)

	}
}

gusb_assay_checklist = paste(sprintf("%#.5f", min.hl60.gus.con.perwell), " (", extract_value(min.hl60.gus.con.perwell.status), ")", sep="")

if (callForReporting == "NEG" || callForReporting == "PNQ"){
	oft_result_checklist = callForReporting
} else {
	if (runType == "absolute"){
		oft_result_checklist = absolute.oft.formatted
	} else {
		oft_result_checklist = relative.oft.formatted
	}
}

if(runType == "absolute"){
	positive_threshold_checklist = absolute.ptv.formatted
} else {
	positive_threshold_checklist = oft.ptv.formatted
}

if(runType == "absolute"){
	negative_threshold_checklist = absolute.ntv.formatted
} else {
	negative_threshold_checklist = oft.ntv.formatted
}

 quality_rna_checklist = extract_value(min.fu.gus.conc.perwell.status)

mdata  <- read_template_file(sample_sheet_file)
```
